name: Arboretum

categories.label: Scoring paths (best path per eligible species)
categories.labelVi: Đường đi ghi điểm (đường tốt nhất mỗi loài được quyền ghi)
categories.hint: Only species where you hold the highest hand total (8 counts 0 if an opponent holds that species' 1). Path starts and ends on that species, values strictly rising. Enter sums over your scoring paths.

categories.label: Species present in your arboretum (tiebreaker)
categories.labelVi: Số loài cây trong vườn (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Not scored; used only to break ties.

tiebreakers.description: Tied player with the most tree species in their arboretum wins.

notes: family: set-collection. pathCards = cards in each scoring path (1 pt each); pathsStartingWithOne = number of scoring paths starting with a 1 (+1 each); pathsEndingWithEight = number ending with an 8 (+2 each); pureCards = cards in scoring paths of 4+ cards made only of the scored species (+1 per card). Right to score a species: highest hand total of that species; ties all qualify. Verified only against BGA game help summary, not the printed rulebook.
